method.description: How it depreciates: straight-line, cost less residual evenly over its life (reducing balance follows in P2).

name.description: What it is called in the register; a line's description when left out.

notes.description: Notes kept with it: its serial number, where it is.

opening.description: An asset bought before the books start, with its opening figures. Send this or source.

residual.description: What it is worth at the end of its life, in the base currency; zero when left out.

source.description: The line it was bought on; its account, purchase date and cost come from that line as its entry posted it. Send this or opening.

start.description: The month depreciation starts: the purchase month when left out, or a later one when it went into use later.
